name: The Hollow Abbot
place: dungeon crypt_spiral: the central vault of the last floor (30-34 m square)
_doc: Stream E. End boss of the crypt spiral. P1 'Vespers': a frontal scythe for the tank, spread bells, and a line-of-sight Dirge you hide from behind the four pillars (each pillar survives two Dirges, so the room runs out of cover). P2 at 65% 'The Procession': he raises a ward and calls the dead; the ward only breaks when all four candle stands are lit, and he tries to SNUFF them with an interruptible breath. P3 'Unhallowed' is a new, shorter health bar: the cracked floor caves in (pits that stay), a three-player stack, a sweeping spiral, and safe circles in the candlelight. Hard enrage at 5.5 minutes. Objects sit inside the 30 m vault (offsets within 12 m of its centre).
party: Solo: very hard — the Rite of Ash stack needs 3 and the candles must be lit while adds chase you. 2-3: playable, stack takes extra damage at 2. 5: intended. M5 scaling: Rite of Ash need = min(3, party); procession adds by party; candle stands 4 -> 3 at two players.

pull: Late again. The dead do not like to be kept waiting.
Another pilgrim for the ossuary. Sit. Stay.
say.death: The Abbot's empty hood folds to the floor. The candles burn on without him.
say.reset: The Abbot returns to his lectern, humming the same three notes.

enrage.say: THE SERVICE IS ENDED. ALL OF YOU, INTO THE GROUND.

grave_bell.name: Grave Bell
grave_bell.say: The bell tolls for each of you — stand apart!

dirge.name: Dirge of the Dead
say: Sing with me. Sing with me.
The Abbot draws a long breath — get behind a pillar!

snuff.name: Snuffing Breath
snuff.say: The Abbot turns toward the candles — stop his breath!

onInterrupt.say: He chokes on his own hymn.

actions.say: Every candle gutters out. Light them again!

procession.name: Procession
procession.say: More of the faithful file in.

rite_of_ash.name: Rite of Ash
rite_of_ash.say: {target} is marked for the rite — share it, three of you!

spiral.name: Ossuary Spiral
spiral.say: Bone dust spirals out from the Abbot!

candlelight.name: Lights Out
candlelight.say: The dark comes in from the walls — stand in the candlelight!

cave_in.name: The Floor Gives Way
cave_in.say: The flagstones crack open beneath you!

phases.name: The Procession
phases.say: Rise, brothers. We have guests at the altar.

onEnter.say: A ward of grey light closes around the Abbot. Light all four candle stands!

phases.name: Unhallowed
phases.say: You put out my light. Then I shall put out yours.

do.say: Four flames! The ward burns away and the Abbot staggers!
The last pillar is dust. Nowhere left to hide from the Dirge!
